create_msa_from_a3m: create an Msa object by parsing a single A3M string with optional max depth cropping
merge_multiple_msas: merge multiple Msa objects into one deduplicated Msa using the from_multiple_msas class method
parse_multiple_a3ms: parse multiple A3M strings into a single deduplicated Msa object using from_multiple_a3ms
featurize_msa: featurize an Msa object to extract msa, deletion matrix, and species identifier numpy arrays
compute_msa_from_sequence: compute an MSA for a target sequence using jackhmmer or nhmmer via get_msa with a run config
